Tom/Kim — I put together a recommended concession that keeps alignment with our standard thresholds but helps Orchid get the coverage they need: 

Proposal (recommended):
- Pilot extension: +6 weeks on top of current 8-week trial (total 14 weeks)
- Platform credits: $15,000 applied to token usage only (to preserve governance for infra/fine-tuning spend)
- Pilot discount: 20% on committed month-1 list rates if Orchid signs an annual reserved commitment within 30 days post-pilot

Rationale: $25k is above the usual pilot credit ceiling for this ARR band; $15k keeps net exposure manageable and gives procurement runway. We can include a deferred invoice option (invoice at contract signature but applied to first 2 months) if they need cashflow timing.

I added a calculator and the HubSpot deal link here for visibility: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3249

If you want me to escalate to Marissa for an exception to match the full $25k, I can do that but will need an explicit business case and ARR commitment estimate from the customer.

Best,
Ben
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: pilot_concession_calculator.xlsx (Excel, 85KB)]

Subject: Exec approval request — Orchid Thermal pilot credits over threshold

Marissa — requesting a quick exec sign-off on a combined concession for Orchid Thermal (DEAL-3249). Context below: 

- ARR band estimate: $120k ARR if they convert to annual reserved capacity
- Customer request: 6-week extension + $25k in credits (tokens + embeddings + potential inference)
- Recommended by AE/SE: 6-week extension + $15k credits + 20% first-month discount + deferred invoice option
- Why make an exception: procurement timeline is tight; loss of momentum likely to push decision out of quarter and increase chance they look at alternatives.
- Financial impact: $15k credit cap + potential 20% first-month reduction (~$6k delta) — net concession ~ $21k against potential $120k ARR.

Request: Exec approval to grant the recommended package OR, if you prefer, approve full $25k credit exception contingent on a signed LOI within 21 days.

Happy to hop on a 15-minute call for context.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Account Executive

- Platform credits: approve up to $12,000 applied to token usage only (not for fine-tuning or managed services)
